scripts.dev:without-schema-push: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && exec pnpm run start
scripts.typecheck: node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --build ../../lib/db ../../lib/api-zod ../../lib/integrations-openai-ai-server --force && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:routes
scripts.test:release:sync:1: vitest run src/routes/sync.integration.test.ts --testNamePattern='^(?!.*\/sync\/events)(?=.*(?:completed-run inventory corrections from sync writes|GET \/sync\/today — combined wake recovery|POST \/sync\/station-activity — server-confirmed station evidence|POST \/sync\/manual-section — section ownership contract|factory purge retains QC history|POST \/sync\/applicator-batch-evidence\/finalize — PostgreSQL authority|server-owned applicator ticks — evidence transaction boundary|server auto-track tick recovery under database pressure|POST \/sync\/operational-intents — canonical transitions|DELETE \/sync\/:date — server-date deletion boundary|\/sync\/today — client-local-date keying|\/sync day breaks — canonical round trips and reset fencing|\/sync large-day complete versus partial measurements|fresh-device unnamed-run remediation|GET \/sync\/conflict-stats))'
scripts.test:release:sync:2: vitest run src/routes/sync.integration.test.ts --testNamePattern='^(?!.*\/sync\/events)(?=.*(?:POST \/sync\/operational-intents — atomic run finalization|GET \/completed-history — bounded stable archive|GET \/sync\/operational-intents\/cursor|GET \/sync\/health — read-only scoped sentinel|POST \/sync\/auto-track\/claim|GET \/sync\/scheduled — client-local-date filtering|\/sync snapshot conditionals|\/sync partial payload contract|\/sync\/today — complete-write causal fence|operational intent service boundary))'
scripts.test:release:sync:3: vitest run src/routes/sync.integration.test.ts --testNamePattern='^(?!.*\/sync\/events)(?=.*(?:\/sync — per-run protective merge|\/sync — additive run-list protection|\/sync — conflict logging to sync_conflict_logs|DELETE \/sync\/:date — server-date guard|PUT \/sync — payload sanitizer))'
scripts.test:release:concurrency: timeout 180s sh -c 'pnpm exec vitest run src/routes/inventory.integration.test.ts --testNamePattern="concurrent|parallel|same run twice" && pnpm exec vitest run src/routes/sync.integration.test.ts --testNamePattern="concurrent|burst under pool pressure|repeated first-write burst"'
